entries.title: Job 12:1
segments: Then Job answered and said,

entries.title: Job 12:2
segments: No doubt but ye are the people, And wisdom shall die with you.

entries.title: Job 12:3
segments: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: Yea, who knoweth not such things as these?

entries.title: Job 12:4
segments: I am as one that is a laughing-stock to his neighbor, I who called upon God, and he answered: The just, the perfect man is a laughing-stock.

entries.title: Job 12:5
segments: In the thought of him that is at ease there is contempt for misfortune; It is ready for them whose foot slippeth.

entries.title: Job 12:6
segments: The tents of robbers prosper, And they that provoke God are secure; Into whose hand God bringeth [abundantly].

entries.title: Job 12:7
segments: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; And the birds of the heavens, and they shall tell thee:

entries.title: Job 12:8
segments: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee; And the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.

entries.title: Job 12:9
segments: Who knoweth not in all these, That the hand of Jehovah hath wrought this,

entries.title: Job 12:10
segments: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, And the breath of all mankind?

entries.title: Job 12:11
segments: Doth not the ear try words, Even as the palate tasteth its food?

entries.title: Job 12:12
segments: With aged men is wisdom, And in length of days understanding.

entries.title: Job 12:13
segments: With [God] is wisdom and might; He hath counsel and understanding.

entries.title: Job 12:14
segments: Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again; He shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.

entries.title: Job 12:15
segments: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up; Again, he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.

entries.title: Job 12:16
segments: With him is strength and wisdom; The deceived and the deceiver are his.

entries.title: Job 12:17
segments: He leadeth counsellors away stripped, And judges maketh he fools.

entries.title: Job 12:18
segments: He looseth the bond of kings, And he bindeth their loins with a girdle.

entries.title: Job 12:19
segments: He leadeth priests away stripped, And overthroweth the mighty.

entries.title: Job 12:20
segments: He removeth the speech of the trusty, And taketh away the understanding of the elders.

entries.title: Job 12:21
segments: He poureth contempt upon princes, And looseth the belt of the strong.

entries.title: Job 12:22
segments: He uncovereth deep things out of darkness,  And bringeth out to light the shadow of death.

entries.title: Job 12:23
segments: He increaseth the nations, and he destroyeth them: He enlargeth the nations, and he leadeth them captive.

entries.title: Job 12:24
segments: He taketh away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, And causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

entries.title: Job 12:25
segments: They grope in the dark without light; And he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man.
